description: Configure basic settings of the system.

option.name: --copy
tip: Copy locale, keymap, timezone, root password and root shell from the host.

option.name: --copy-keymap
tip: Copy the keymap from the host.

option.name: --copy-locale
tip: Copy the locale from the host.

option.name: --copy-root-password
tip: Copy the root password from the host.

option.name: --copy-root-shell
tip: Copy the root shell from the host.

option.name: --copy-timezone
tip: Copy the timezone from the host.

option.name: --delete-root-password
tip: Delete the root password.

option.name: --force
tip: Overwrite existing files.

option.name: --help
tip: Show this help.

option.name: --hostname
tip: Set the hostname.

option.name: --image
tip: Operate on a disk image as the filesystem root.

option.name: --image-policy
tip: Specify the disk image dissection policy.

option.name: --kernel-command-line
tip: Set the kernel command line.

option.name: --keymap
tip: Set the keymap.

option.name: --locale
tip: Set the primary locale (LANG=).

option.name: --locale-messages
tip: Set the message locale (LC_MESSAGES=).

option.name: --machine-id
tip: Set the specified machine ID.

option.name: --prompt
tip: Prompt for all of the above.

option.name: --prompt-hostname
tip: Prompt the user for the hostname.

option.name: --prompt-keymap
tip: Prompt the user for keymap settings.

option.name: --prompt-locale
tip: Prompt the user for locale settings.

option.name: --prompt-root-password
tip: Prompt the user for the root password.

option.name: --prompt-root-shell
tip: Prompt the user for the root shell.

option.name: --prompt-timezone
tip: Prompt the user for the timezone.

option.name: --reset
tip: Remove existing files.

option.name: --root
tip: Operate on an alternate filesystem root.

option.name: --root-password
tip: Set the root password from a plaintext password.

option.name: --root-password-file
tip: Set the root password from a file.

option.name: --root-password-hashed
tip: Set the root password from a hashed password.

option.name: --root-shell
tip: Set the root shell.

option.name: --setup-machine-id
tip: Set a random machine ID.

option.name: --timezone
tip: Set the timezone.

option.name: --version
tip: Show package version.

option.name: --welcome
tip: Disable the welcome text.
